name: learning-mcp
description: Adaptive pedagogy engine (learner profile, stage progression, intervention budgeting, Socratic checkpoints) over MCP.

tools.name: learning_checkpoint
tools.description: Consult the pedagogy engine before interrupting the learner with a Socratic checkpoint. Enforces per-mode gating: autonomous never interrupts; socratic-tutor enforces the session intervention budget (default 3); mastered concepts are suppressed unless marked needs-reinforcement; concepts whose prerequisites need reinforcement are suppressed. When interrupt is true, exposed evidence is recorded in the learner profile.

tools.name: record_learning_evidence
tools.description: Record observed learning evidence for a concept. Stage progression is monotonic: evidence never regresses a concept to an earlier stage; needs-reinforcement flags the concept for review without lowering its stage.

tools.name: decision_checkpoint
tools.description: Record a decision brief before committing to an architectural approach (co-architect mode). The brief is stored in the session ledger and always requires human approval before mutation proceeds.

tools.name: resolve_decision_checkpoint
tools.description: Resolve a pending decision brief with a human approval or rejection. Unknown brief ids are a tool error.

tools.name: learner_profile
tools.description: Read the persisted learner profile: every tracked concept with its current monotonic stage and recent evidence.

discovery.note: Complete, stable tools/list is always served. This card carries a compact index (names, descriptions, risk hints) for hosts that progressively disclose model-visible definitions; tool definitions are never made connection-local or model-use-dependent.
